title: Helicopter harassment after AARO testimony
place_text: Herrera's home, father's residence and business

tellings.quote: But one of the instances, so when I testified to Arrow in April of 2023, After that trip, I started having these helicopters hover over my house or, you know, my dad's residence for example or over my business.

plain: In April 2023, Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a huge UFO in the Indonesian jungle, testified to AARO, the Pentagon office set up to look into unexplained sightings. He tells Michels that after that trip, helicopters began hovering over his house, his father's home and his business. To Herrera, it was harassment over what he had told the government.
